svg.title: Muscular artery
svg.desc: An oblique section through an idealised muscular artery distinguishes the outer supporting coat, muscular media, internal elastic lamina, intima and lumen. Sparse surface vessels are shown.
svg.text: Oblique section through the vessel wall

text.tspan: Illustrative muscular artery. Wall thickness and layer proportions are exaggerated for visibility; not a quantitative histological
Anatomical reference: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, section 20.1.
